title: Raw degree-zero and degree-one scalar coordinates and residue naturality
statement: Let $W$ be a scheme, $w\in U$ an affine open, $m\in\mathbb N$, and $d\in\Gamma(W,U)^m$. Let $K$ be a strictly perfect cochain complex on the localized module site over $U$ [def-pc-perfect-complex], and let $e_0:\Gamma(K^0)\simeq\Gamma(W,U)$ and $e_1:\Gamma(K^1)\simeq\Gamma(W,U)^m$ be linear equivalences. Suppose $e_1(d_K^0(e_0^{-1}(a)))=a d$ for every $a\in\Gamma(W,U)$. Put $p:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(w)\to U$ equal to the residue lift [def-sc-picard-derived-model-sections], with residue field as in [def-weil-residue-field]. Write $A(K^j)$ for the sheaf obtained from the localized module site by the open equivalence, and use the ordinary tensor pullbacks and raw restriction of [def-sc-picard-ordinary-model-cycles]. For $t:T\to W$ and $s:T\to U$, set $H^j(t,s)=\operatorname{Hom}(t^*\mathcal O_W,s^*A(K^j))$, and let $D_s:H^0(t,s)\to H^1(t,s)$ be postcomposition with $s^*A(d_K^0)$. There exist additive equivalences $b:H^0(W.fromSpecResidueField(w),p)\simeq\kappa(w)$ and $b_1:H^1(W.fromSpecResidueField(w),p)\simeq\kappa(w)^m$, and, for every open $V\subseteq U$, additive equivalences $c_V:H^0(V\to W,V\to U)\simeq\Gamma(W,V)$ and $c_{1,V}:H^1(V\to W,V\to U)\simeq\Gamma(W,V)^m$, such that $b_1(D_p(f))=b(f)(d_i(w))_i$ for every raw residue morphism $f$, and $c_{1,V}(D_{V\to U}(f))=c_V(f)(d_i|_V)_i$ for every raw morphism $f$ on $V$. Moreover, if $w\in V$ and the residue lift $p_V$ composed with $V\to U$ equals $p$, then $b(\operatorname{res}_{p_V}(f))=c_V(f)(w)$ for the raw restriction pinned by that equality. No vanishing of the coefficients, scalar annihilation hypothesis, cycle membership, or cycle existence is asserted.

theorem picard_ordinary_raw_coordinates
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W)
    (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (m : ℕ) (d : Fin m → Γ(W, U))
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect W U K)
    (e0 : (K.X 0).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) ≃ₗ[Γ(W, U)] Γ(W, U))
    (e1 : (K.X 1).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) ≃ₗ[Γ(W, U)] (Fin m → Γ(W, U)))
    (hd : ∀ a : Γ(W, U), e1 ((K.d 0 1).val.app (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (e0.symm a)) = a • d) :
    let p := picardResidueLift W w U hwU
    ∃ (b : ((Modules.tensorPullback (W.fromSpecResidueField w)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace)) ⟶
          (Modules.tensorPullback p).obj ((Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj (K.X 0))) ≃+
            W.residueField w)
      (b1 : ((Modules.tensorPullback (W.fromSpecResidueField w)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace)) ⟶
          (Modules.tensorPullback p).obj ((Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj (K.X 1))) ≃+
            (Fin m → W.residueField w))
      (c : ∀ (V : W.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U),
        ((Modules.tensorPullback V.ι).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace)) ⟶
            (Modules.tensorPullback (W.homOfLE hVU)).obj
              ((Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj (K.X 0))) ≃+ Γ(W, V))
      (c1 : ∀ (V : W.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U),
        ((Modules.tensorPullback V.ι).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace)) ⟶
            (Modules.tensorPullback (W.homOfLE hVU)).obj
              ((Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj (K.X 1))) ≃+ (Fin m → Γ(W, V))),
      (∀ f, b1 (f ≫ (Modules.tensorPullback p).map
          ((Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (K.d 0 1))) =
        b f • (fun i ↦ W.evaluation U w hwU (d i))) ∧
      (∀ (V : W.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) f,
        c1 V hVU (f ≫ (Modules.tensorPullback (W.homOfLE hVU)).map
          ((Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (K.d 0 1))) =
        c V hVU f • (fun i ↦ W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (d i))) ∧
      ∀ (V : W.Opens) (hwV : w ∈ V) (hVU : V ≤ U)
        (hs : picardResidueLift W w V hwV ≫ W.homOfLE hVU = p) f,
        b (picardOrdinaryModelRestriction W U K (picardResidueLift W w V hwV)
          V.ι (W.fromSpecResidueField w) (W.homOfLE hVU) p
          (picardResidueLift_comp W w V hwV) hs f) =
            W.evaluation V w hwV (c V hVU f)
